instructions.title: v36: longer box and simple cap screws
instructions.text: Print one matched v36 cap and box pair first. Box is 6mm longer at the metal-bracket end; the knee servo, knee joint/pivot and downstream assembly are 6mm farther out (hip-to-knee90→96mm). Seat the servo and cap, then use two 3x8mm plastic self-tapping screws through the cap face into its mid-height wall pilots. No nuts or loading slots. Both heads must fit the Ø6 x3mm recesses. Pilots are Ø2.5 x8mm deep; nominal screw entry into plastic is6mm, about5mm excluding the modeled tip. Dry-test your actual screw profile and avoid overtightening. Repeated service wears plastic threads. CAD clearances are tested, not printed pullout/fatigue strength. Six front bracket insert pockets remain3.1mm deep.
